name: Dynamic Workspaces
author: Dominik Mikolajczyk
description: Profile-aware workspace management for changing monitor setups.

barWidget.description: A control icon and a grouped workspace display, selectable per widget instance.

schema.label: Widget mode
schema.description: Control shows the panel icon. Workspaces renders configured groups at the existing workspace position.

schema.label: Panel icon
schema.description: Any text, emoji, or Nerd Font glyph displayed on the bar.
